transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

I came because… things at home have gone too far. My in-laws aren’t just arguing with me. They’re using the altar, and the parish committee, to push me out… to make people forget what I’ve done for this family.
Do you believe your in-laws are deliberately trying to harm or get rid of you?
Yes… I do. They’re not just disagreeing with me. They’re using the altar, the parish committee… trying to push me out, make people forget everything I’ve done for this family.
Has anyone else actually seen proof that your in-laws are using the altar or parish committee against you?

I… I don’t know if they’d call it proof. People saw what happened at the church, the way the altar and parish committee were used. I know what they were doing—trying to push me out, make everyone forget what I’ve done.
Even if other people disagree, are you completely certain your in-laws are using the altar and parish committee to push you out?
Yes. I’m certain. They weren’t just arguing with me… they used the altar and the parish committee to push me out, to make people forget what I’ve done for this family.
Have you heard voices when no one else was there?
Yes… a few nights. I heard my mother’s voice—she’s passed—telling me where to put the marigolds and candles. And once I thought I saw her by the kitchen doorway, but my husband said no one was there.
During this time, have you felt unusually energetic, like you needed much less sleep than usual?
Yes… I suppose so. I wasn’t really resting. I kept cleaning, calling people, changing the menus over and over, moving boxes of decorations around… even when they told me to sit down.
Did all of this start very suddenly, over a few days?
I don’t really know. It felt like it built up… but I wasn’t keeping track of the days.
At the same time this was happening, did you feel unusually happy or excited?
Yes… some days I felt very bright, like I was sure about everything. But if someone questioned me about the altar, I’d snap. It felt like they were insulting my whole family.
Have these experiences been going on for less than one month?
No… I think it’s been longer than that. Maybe about two months, since that fight with my in-laws over the altar.
Have there been times in these past two months when you still felt your in-laws were using the altar or parish committee against you, even when your energy and mood had returned to normal?

Not exactly… the hearing things, and seeing my mother, that was only when I wasn’t sleeping and I was rushing around, feeling like I had to fix the altar.

Later, when my mood came down, I still felt guilty and sad about it all… but I wasn’t hearing or seeing those things then.
During this time, did you feel unusually irritable most of the day?
Yes… I suppose so. I was on edge a lot. If anyone questioned me about the altar, I’d snap at them, like they were insulting my family.
